newsitem.title: UK: John Lewis UK store sales up 31.7% in week.
newsitem.headline: John Lewis UK store sales up 31.7% in week.

text.p: The John Lewis Partnership said its UK department store sales rose 31.7 percent in the week to January 4 compared with the same week a year earlier.
In the 23 weeks to January 4, sales were up 12.3 percent year-on-year.
Total sales, including the Waitrose supermarket chain, rose 25.7 percent in the week and were up 10.6 percent in the 23-week period.
"The comparisons for last year are far from straightforward but we can be well pleased with an increase handsomely in front of what had seemed likely," a company spokesman said.
He added that the large increase in sales in weeks 22 and 23 confirmed that "the advance of the calendar pushed our trade significantly later than a year ago."
